components.name: llm.models
components.responsibility: Provider-agnostic domain model: Prompt, Conversation, Response, Tool/Toolbox and tool-call chaining that every model plugin implements.

components.name: llm (root modules)
components.responsibility: Plugin host: a pluggy PluginManager loads default plugins and setuptools entry points in group 'llm' and exposes hook specs for models, commands, tools and template loaders.

components.name: llm.default_plugins
components.responsibility: Bundled plugin that registers OpenAI chat and embedding models through the same hooks third-party plugins use.

architecture_hypotheses.claim: Model providers are plugins: the core defines pluggy hook specs and loads providers dynamically; OpenAI support is itself a default plugin.
counter_evidence_notes: searched core components (llm.cli, llm.models, llm.logs) for direct openai imports: none; the openai signal is confined to llm.default_plugins.openai_models and is not statically reachable from any entry point
architecture_hypotheses.how_to_falsify: Find a static import of llm.default_plugins.openai_models from llm.cli or llm.models in dependency-graph.json.

architecture_hypotheses.claim: CLI on top of a provider-agnostic domain layer (models) on top of persistence (logs/SQLite).
counter_evidence_notes: components.import_time_cycles contains llm.cli, llm.models, llm.logs and the synthetic root bucket: the layers are not strictly ordered (partly an artefact of the merged bucket)
architecture_hypotheses.how_to_falsify: Re-run with --component-depth 2 on a split of the root bucket and check whether llm.models still depends on llm.cli at import time.

primitive_roles.rationale: One provider among many, loaded as a plugin; the core is provider-agnostic.
pluggy PluginManager is how every model, command and tool reaches the CLI.
Logs prompts/responses and stores embeddings; not on the generation path.

ai_assessment.rationale: The product's output is model responses, but the concrete provider is interchangeable via plugins.

unknowns.question: How much real-world usage goes through third-party plugins rather than the bundled OpenAI plugin?
unknowns.reason: Plugins are installed separately and are not visible in this repository.
